markers.text: I feel sad, like the colour of the bamboo in the rain.
I feel happy, like the colour of  Guotiao in Yongan.
I feel angry, like the colour of the weather in Yongan.
I feel excited, like the colour of Sanming Team in Minchao.
I feel surprised, like the colour of Daqiang Opera from Qingshui, Yong'an.
